title: OpenAI Fundraising Round Set to Close Soon With UAE Investors, Coatue Leading Investment
text:
OpenAI is aiming to close a $30 billion fundraising round that will value the AI company at up to $1.25 trillion, not including the new investment, before the end of next week, according to a person familiar with the deal.
